Inter
=====

Self-hosted WOFF2 files from Google Fonts, downloaded 2026-10-08.
Google Fonts distribution version: v20.
Variable weights: 400-700, normal and true italic.
Subsets: Latin and Latin Extended.

These are the same font variants used in the local font comparison.
The regular Latin subset is preloaded in _layouts/liquid.html.

Project: https://rsms.me/inter/
CSS source: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:ital,wght@0,400..700;1,400..700&display=swap
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt).
License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/inter/OFL.txt

Original WOFF2 sources:

  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7W0Q5nw.woff2

  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa25L7W0Q5n-wU.woff2

  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC53FwrK3iLTcvneQg7Ca725JhhKnNqk6L5UUMbndwV.woff2
